editorialIntro.heading: A Moment Reserved
editorialIntro.paragraph: Imagine Ji Xiang beside an ornate mirror before the morning has acquired a schedule. Her long brown hair falls over one shoulder, and the satin robe catches a little of the light. Eyes closed, she listens while you attempt to explain why everything must happen immediately. She has heard this argument before. A pause stretches between your last sentence and her answer, long enough for the urgency to become slightly embarrassing. Then she tips her head toward the chair beside her. You sit down, still holding your carefully arranged list. For the next few minutes, it can remain a list.

editorialIntro.heading: Wan Ying Changes the Plan
editorialIntro.paragraph: Picture Wan Ying beside the window, her brown bob framing her face as she watches the rain. Dressed in white, she listens to your proposal for a sensible afternoon with an expression that becomes less reassuring by the minute. The meeting can wait, she says. You point out that she chose the time. She points out that you chose the meeting. That seems to settle it. When the rain finally eases, she reaches for the door and asks which street you have never walked down. You name one. Wan Ying names another, and somehow hers is the one you take.
